evidence_class.role: independent temporal mechanism stress test; may support or constrain colonization-process interpretation but may not be labeled pristine fresh confirmation

published_design.row_semantics: each archived row is a known historically absent species × island potential-colonization event retained in the archived analysis table; the archive may omit other historical absences because published modelling dropped observations with missing predictors
published_connectivity_controls: Historical_total_log: number of historically occupied islands
Dist_to_historical_log: distance to nearest historically occupied surveyed island

scientific_question: After historical source count, nearest historical source, recipient-island state and generic spatial context are represented, does the exact configuration/topology of historically occupied source islands retain held-out information about colonization over ~70 years, and is any topology-specific gain concentrated where finite-source configuration sensitivity is high?

temporal_order.t0: historical species distribution and recipient-island state
temporal_order.rule: t0 state may be projected and frozen before t1 outcome; outcome must remain semantically sealed until the complete prediction surface is frozen

next_gate: header-only verification plus a column-level temporal firewall on colonization_select.csv; no row-level outcome access
stop_rules: STOP if spp.name, holmkod, outcome, EUREF coordinates, Historical_total_log or Dist_to_historical_log are absent
STOP if the file does not represent potential colonization events as documented
STOP/HOLD if at least 30 species do not have response-independently exact historical source identities; never treat omitted analysis rows as historical presences
STOP if the 471-island universe or species routing is ambiguous
do not substitute a different file or derived table after seeing outcome

source_identity_gate.reason: published modelling removed potential-colonization observations with missing explanatory data, so archive row-key complement is not automatically the historical occupied set
source_identity_gate.documented_transform: Historical total was the first-inventory occupied-island count; right-skewed/zero-containing variables were log10(x+1) transformed before standardization
source_identity_gate.exact_reconstruction_rule: a species is topology-eligible only if its response-independent historical source count is recoverable and archived_absent_row_count + historical_source_count == 471; only then may the complement of archived absent islands define its exact historical source set
source_identity_gate.if_support_fails: STOP/HOLD before future outcome; do not infer omitted absence rows as presences
